lines.text: Uranus. It rotates on its side, so this whole season is forty-two years of shadow. Methane snow is falling - light as frost, cold as space.
Slippery ground, cryo geysers, and scouts on saucers. The Thermal Regulator is the warmest thing for a billion kilometres.
Methane storm. The temperature is dropping with every gust - do not linger.
Thermal Regulator recovered. We will not freeze on the ride home now.
Regulator stowed. Minus 195 degrees out here - that is a real number, not a feeling.
Geysers freeze-fast and thaw-slow. Move when the steam dies down.
Snow drifts cut your speed. Long strides beat short hops here.
Bounce on the scouts - their saucers fold in one stomp.
